properties.notes: Vacant former workshop premises within Berwick town centre. Redevelopment would involve the demolition of the redundant building prior to new-build scheme. A higher density development could be suitable given the central location, potentially a flatted scheme. A previous permission for 11 flats lapsed without commencement (12/01670/FUL). Related applications for demolition also approved but similarly works were not progressed (05/B/0272, 12/01671/CON). Recently confirmed that the landowner is still considering options for the site and is looking forward to bringing forward a scheme in near future. Currently considered developable later in the plan period.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
